title: Test full signup migration flow with actual song practice
description: After BUG-028 fix, test the COMPLETE flow: practice a song as anonymous user, then signup with migration checkbox, verify data transfers.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Clear localStorage and start fresh anonymous session
Click play on video - verify audio is ON and playing
Click on a lyric line to interact with it
Mark at least one word as learned
Verify localStorage has songscript_visitor_id with practice data
Checkbox is checked by default (bring my progress)
Toggle checkbox off and on - verify it works visually
Fill email and display name, submit with checkbox CHECKED
No console errors during entire flow

notes:
This is the REAL end-to-end test of the signup migration flow.

TEMPMAIL MCP - For signup testing:
- Use `create_email` to get a disposable email address
- Fill signup form with the temp email
- Use `get_messages` to check inbox for magic link
- Use `get_message_detail` to read the magic link email
- Extract the verify URL and navigate to it
- After test, email auto-expires (no cleanup needed)

Use browser MCP tools:
- mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer action='screenshot' for visual verification
- mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer action='left_click' to interact
- mcp__claude-in-chrome__javascript_tool to check localStorage
- mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages to verify no errors

IMPORTANT: Actually play the video and verify audio works - don't just check UI state.

CLEANUP - Use Convex oneTimeMigration functions:
- npx convex run oneTimeMigration:deleteTestUserByEmail '{"email": "test@example.com"}' - deletes from BOTH Better Auth and app users
- npx convex run oneTimeMigration:listAllAppUsers - see all users
- npx convex run oneTimeMigration:checkUserData '{"userId": "xxx"}' - check user's data

IF SOMETHING DOESN'T WORK:
Create a new bug story via prd-json/update.json with detailed findings. Use /prd skill. Don't mark this story as passed if there are unresolved issues - create BUG-029 or similar instead.
